Treatment of Fractures • Basically Same as Soft Tissue Injuries Treatment Stage 1 (First week) • Gao: Use Qi Li San or Die Da Wan. • Cannot tonify until blockage is moved. • Refrain from exercise Treatment Stage 2 (second Week) • Use Herbal Formulas to help the bone mend and eliminate residual stasis. • Must make sure to eliminate stasis first or tonics will exacerbate the condition. • Acupuncture and Tui Na are used to keep channels open and break up restrictions, relax spasms, and prevent atrophy • Formulas like Early Stage Bone Knitting or Rib Fracture Formula Some exercise

Treatment Stage 3 (Third and Fourth weeks) • By the third stage (3rd week) if treated properly, there should be no residual swelling or cold and damp. appropriate modifications. • Can use Late Stage Bone Knitting Pill • Acupuncture and Tui Na are used to keep channels open and break up restrictions, relax spasms, prevent atrophy • Some Exercise Treatment Stage 4 (5th and 6th Weeks) • At about 4- 6 weeks the bones should be knit. • If failure to knit – Late Stage bone Knitting Pill and/or bone broth • Constitutional formulas or formulas that tonify Kidney Yin or Yang can be used in this phase. • Acupuncture and Tui Na are used to keep channels open and break up restrictions, relax spasms, prevent atrophy. • Exercise becomes much more important in this phase –stimulates remodeling and bony growth • Soaks can be used to soften spasms and contractures in soft tissue after the bones are fully knit.
